scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @proliferate/cloud-sdk build && pnpm --filter @proliferate/cloud-sdk-react build && pnpm --filter @proliferate/design build && pnpm --filter @proliferate/product-domain build
scripts.build:ios: pnpm build:shared && pnpm dlx eas-cli@18.13.0 build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:ios:preview: pnpm build:shared && pnpm dlx eas-cli@18.13.0 build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.submit:ios: pnpm dlx eas-cli@18.13.0 submit --platform ios --profile production

install.//: Held out of SDK version-matching so `expo install --fix`/expo-doctor don't realign them. The React family stays at 19.2 (react-native 0.85 peers react ^19.2.0). TypeScript stays at the monorepo-wide ^5.7 (=5.9.x): SDK 56 prefers TS 6.0, but the shared @proliferate/* packages built during `mobile typecheck` still use tsconfig `baseUrl` (removed in TS 6/7), so the workspace moves to TS 6 as one migration, not here.
